description:
Check the presence-day test for New Zealand citizenship by grant.

    Use for: 'how many days do I need in NZ for citizenship', 'NZ citizenship
    eligibility', '1350 days citizenship', '240 days rule NZ citizenship',
    'can I apply for NZ citizenship yet', 'citizenship presence calculator'.

    BOTH TESTS MUST PASS, AND NEITHER RESCUES THE OTHER. Over the five years
    immediately before applying (Citizenship Act 1977 s8(2)(b)): at least
    1,350 days in New Zealand in total, AND at least 240 days in each of the
    five years. A comfortable total of 1,410 still fails if one 12-month
    period was 230. Five bare minimums of 240 total only 1,200, which fails
    the total. Lead with whichever test failed and by how much.

    ONLY DAYS ENTITLED TO BE IN NZ INDEFINITELY COUNT: for example on a
    resident or permanent resident visa, as an Australian citizen, or as an NZ
    citizen by descent (DIA Guidance 1(a)). Time on a work, student or visitor
    visa does not count towards either test. DIA has confirmed in writing
    (reply to data.govt.nz dataset request 847, 18 September 2023) that the
    days you leave and arrive in New Zealand both count as days in New
    Zealand.

    A "YEAR" IS A 12-MONTH PERIOD COUNTED BACK FROM THE DATE DIA RECEIVES THE
    COMPLETED APPLICATION AND FEE, not a calendar year. All five periods move
    with that date, so a later date can pass where today fails, but it needs
    a fresh count of all five, not just a low period falling away.

    This is eligibility guidance only. Applications are decided by the
    Minister of Internal Affairs, or by the Department of Internal Affairs
    under delegated authority, who also assess DIA's six other requirements:
    entitlement to reside indefinitely, good character, knowledge of the
    responsibilities and privileges of citizenship, English language,
    intention to reside and full capacity (in other_requirements).

    Args:
        days_per_year: Five day counts, MOST RECENT FIRST (months 1 to 12
            before applying, then 13 to 24, ... 49 to 60). Each a whole
            number, 0 to 366.

    Returns:
        Whether the presence requirement is met, the total against 1,350, each
        period against 240 with its margin, the number of periods below 240,
        the page's plain-language verdict and explanation, and DIA's seven
        requirements.
name: nz_citizenship_calculator
